newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National Assembly speaker Fredrick Chien offers resignation over opposition members questioning of his ability to chair meeting, but retracts the resignation later
-- President Lee Teng-hui apologises for worsening social order
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui vows not to run for next term
-- National Assembly speaker Fredrick Chien considers resigning
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui gives greenlight for Premier Lien Chan to step down after completion of constitution amendments
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central banks vows not to intervene in fluctuated stock market
-- President Lee Teng-hui takes blame for deteriorating social order
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Securities & Exchange Commission concerned about selling spree at local bourse by investment and trust companies
-- Taiwan Provincial Assembly completes first reading of bill allowing provincial government to keep less than 51 pct of shares of three provincial commercial banks
